profile.primary: SAME_WORLD_1, each table and both together: the mean distance between a model's two sessions (its own pair, same frozen world), against every way of pairing the ten sessions of a table into five pairs (945 per table; 945² for both tables) — exact one-sided p = the share of pairings whose mean pair distance is at most the observed. The question: does a model's profile agree with its own second session more than with other models'?
profile.secondary: the nearest neighbour (how many of a table's ten sessions have their own pair as nearest; ties shared), exact over the same pairings
profile.exploratory: family: over every town session (group 1, group 2, DeepSeek, SAME_WORLD_1), the mean distance between sessions of the same provider family (excluding a model's own pairs) against different families, family labels shuffled within each stage × table block, 10 000 shuffles; and the authorship domain (fact choice × domain) beside
